posts.title: The Area Under the Curve: Why You Should Maximize the Integral of Happiness, Not the Spikes
posts.description: Optimizing life for dramatic peak experiences is a fundamental error in calculus. Why elevating your daily baseline beats chasing spikes—and four principles for maximizing your lifetime area under the curve.

posts.description: AI has quietly shattered Paul Graham's Maker vs. Manager schedule divide. Here is how managers can use AI to prototype, clear paper cuts, and stay close to the craft—without turning into seagull managers.
